cases.title: Jira outage loses no ticket and retries at most 3 times
cases.given: A new error in the log and a mocked Jira that answers 503 to every request
then: The ticket stays in the queue in the state file
Jira receives at most 3 create attempts
The agent log has one alert after the third failure

cases.title: Create-only Jira access and no secrets in code or logs
cases.given: The agent's code, the .env values and a full run against a mocked Jira
cases.when: The code and the agent log are searched for the token and key values, and all HTTP calls to Jira are recorded

cases.title: A 50 MB log is processed within 5 minutes
cases.given: 50 MB of new log lines and mocked Jira and LLM services
then: The run finishes in under 5 minutes

cases.title: LLM failure still creates a ticket
cases.given: A new error event and an LLM that returns text that is not valid S-002 JSON
then: Its title is taken from the raw log line

cases.title: A repeated error gives exactly one ticket
cases.given: The same error written 100 times to the log within 10 minutes
then: Exactly one ticket exists for it

cases.title: Happy path: a new error becomes a complete Jira ticket within 15 minutes
cases.given: A Jira test project, a running scheduler and a new ERROR line written to a log file
then: One Bug exists in the test project
It has title, summary, log excerpt, first-seen time, occurrence count and priority

cases.title: Support team confirms last week's tickets
cases.given: Last week's log files and a Jira test project
cases.when: The agent runs over them and the support team reviews the tickets
then: The number of tickets equals the number of distinct errors
The team confirms the tickets are right

cases.title: An error already ticketed in an earlier run gets no new ticket
cases.given: An error that got a ticket in a previous run, recorded in the state file
cases.when: The same error appears again and the agent runs

cases.title: Only new lines are read
cases.given: A log file already read up to its end in the previous run
cases.when: The agent runs with no new lines

cases.title: Only ERROR, FATAL and CRITICAL lines become error events
cases.given: A log with INFO, DEBUG and WARN lines and one error line followed by a stack trace
then: Exactly one S-001 event is produced
Its stack field holds the stack-trace lines

cases.title: Wrong Jira credentials stop the run without retries
cases.given: A new error and a mocked Jira that answers 401
then: The ticket stays in the queue with its attempt count unchanged
The agent log has one credentials alert

cases.title: Empty or missing log file is skipped
cases.given: An empty log file and a configured file that does not exist

cases.title: Unreadable lines are skipped and counted
cases.given: A log file with 3 binary lines and one readable error line
then: The run summary reports 3 skipped lines

cases.title: P-001 returns valid S-002 JSON
cases.given: One ERROR event about a payments-api timeout
then: The output is valid JSON matching S-002
Its priority is one of Highest, High, Medium, Low

cases.title: P-001 separates different errors
cases.given: Two events with different causes, a database connection refusal and a missing field
